name: Factions - Panzerhunds Go Berserk
author: wolfsdk
description: faction/auth/panzerhund is a faction of its own (6 entityDefs), but it only inherits from faction/auth through parentFaction and has no relationships block of its own. This mod adds faction/auth there with ATTITUDE_HATE: Panzerhunds should then attack the 237 enemies on their own side. Adding an entry instead of creating a new one -- the patcher could not get a new faction into the archive. The reverse direction (faction/auth hates the Panzerhund) stays open; whether guards shoot back depends on whether the AI reacts to damage it takes. Untested in game: built and checked, but never launched.
